_comment: 人工挑选的新闻：一条「AI 进展」(signal) 配一条「现实检验」(check)。occ 是 O*NET 英文职业名（这些职业的证据面板会置顶显示），fields 是领域代码（同领域其他职业的「领域动态」也会显示）。collect.py 每次运行都会把这里的内容原样并入 web/news.json。

zh.t: OpenAI 称其通用推理模型推翻了 Erdős 一个 80 年的几何猜想
zh.p: 问题关于平面上等距点对的数量；OpenAI 称外部数学家审核了证明，这个模型并非专为数学训练。

en.t: OpenAI says its general reasoning model disproved an 80-year-old Erdős geometry conjecture
en.p: The problem concerns the number of unit-distance pairs in the plane. OpenAI says outside mathematicians checked the proof and that the model was not trained specifically for math.

zh.t: 推翻的是「上界已最优」的猜想，正确的界仍然未知
zh.p: 构造用到的思路文献里已有，Princeton 的 Will Sawin 很快改进了它。2025 年 10 月 OpenAI 还曾把文献里已有的 Erdős 解答当成新成果。

en.t: It disproved that the known upper bound is optimal; the correct bound is still unknown
en.p: The construction builds on ideas already in the literature, and Princeton's Will Sawin quickly improved it. In October 2025 OpenAI had also presented existing Erdős solutions as new results.

zh.t: Anthropic 称 Claude 在 DNA 数据库里自主找到一个类 CRISPR 的酶系统
zh.p: Claude 检索了 21 小时，研究人员只给了高层方向；这个系统被命名为 ART，可能是一种新的基因编辑机制。

en.t: Anthropic says Claude independently found a CRISPR-like enzyme system in DNA databases
en.p: Claude searched for 21 hours with only high-level direction from researchers. The system, named ART, may be a new gene-editing mechanism.

zh.t: 功能还没确定，哥本哈根的团队说他们一年前就发现了它
zh.p: 这个系统还没有湿实验验证。哥本哈根大学一位生物学家称其团队约一年前已发现该酶，用过 Claude，只是尚未发表；Anthropic 否认用用户对话训练。

en.t: Its function is unconfirmed, and a Copenhagen team says it found the system a year earlier
en.p: The system has not been validated in the wet lab. A University of Copenhagen biologist says her team found the enzyme about a year ago, had used Claude, and had not yet published; Anthropic denies training on user conversations.

zh.t: AI agent 能独立完成的任务长度，2023 年后约每 4.3 个月翻一倍
zh.p: METR 用人类专家完成任务的时长衡量 AI 能力；2026 年 1 月的更新显示进展在加速。这正是本页倒计时用的曲线。

en.t: The length of tasks AI agents can complete alone has doubled about every 4.3 months since 2023
en.p: METR measures AI capability by how long the tasks take human experts. Its January 2026 update shows progress speeding up. This is the curve this page uses.

zh.t: 随机对照实验：资深开发者用 AI 工具后反而慢了 19%
zh.p: 16 位资深开源开发者在自己的仓库里做真实任务；他们事前以为会快 24%，事后仍以为快了 20%。

en.t: Randomized trial: experienced developers were 19% slower with AI tools
en.p: 16 experienced open-source developers worked on real tasks in their own repositories. Beforehand they expected to be 24% faster; afterwards they still believed they had been 20% faster.

zh.t: Klarna 称 AI 助手承担了 700 人的工作量
zh.p: 高峰时 AI 处理了约 75% 的客服对话，覆盖 35 种以上语言。

en.t: Klarna says its AI assistant does the work of 700 people
en.p: At its peak, the AI handled about 75% of customer service chats in more than 35 languages.

zh.t: 服务质量下滑后，Klarna 重新招聘人工客服
zh.p: CEO 承认之前偏重 AI 的做法不对，客户往往更想和人沟通，现在改成 AI 加人工的双轨模式。

en.t: After service quality fell, Klarna is hiring human agents again
en.p: The CEO admitted the AI-heavy approach went too far; customers often prefer a person, so Klarna now runs AI and human support side by side.

zh.t: 美国联邦法院同时处罚原被告双方律师：文书引用了 AI 编造的判例
zh.p: 密西西比北区法院对 4 名律师罚款，其中两人被禁止在该法院执业两年，原定的庭审也被取消。

en.t: A US federal court sanctioned lawyers on both sides for citing AI-fabricated cases
en.p: The Northern District of Mississippi fined four lawyers, barred two from practicing before the court for two years, and cancelled the scheduled trial.

zh.t: 四大会计师事务所开始让 AI agent 直接执行审计任务
zh.p: EY 从 2026 年 4 月起把一部分日记账分录分析交给 AI agent；KPMG、Deloitte 也在审计平台里上线了 agent，PwC 称 2026 年度的审计将全流程接入 AI。

en.t: Big Four firms are rolling out AI agents that carry out audit tasks
en.p: Since April 2026 EY has handed part of its journal-entry analysis to AI agents; KPMG and Deloitte have built agents into their audit platforms, and PwC says its 2026 audits will be AI-integrated end to end.

zh.t: 德勤澳洲因报告含 AI 编造内容，向政府部分退款
zh.p: 这份 44 万澳元的政府报告里有编造的法官引语和不存在的参考文献，一位研究者找出最多 20 处错误。德勤称这些错误不影响报告的结论。

en.t: Deloitte Australia partly refunds the government over a report with AI-fabricated content
en.p: The A$440,000 government report contained a fabricated quote from a judge and references to nonexistent work; a researcher found up to 20 errors. Deloitte said the errors did not change the report's findings.

zh.t: Gartner 建议数据团队准备从 BI 仪表盘转向「分析 agent」
zh.p: 企业分析正从拖拽式仪表盘转向自然语言提问，分析 agent 开始和静态仪表盘一起使用。

en.t: Gartner tells data teams to prepare for a shift from BI dashboards to analytics agents
en.p: Enterprise analytics is moving from drag-and-drop dashboards to natural-language questions, as analytics agents begin to complement static dashboards.

zh.t: 企业级 SQL 调试测试：最好的模型也只做对约三分之一
zh.p: 在平均超过 140 行的真实风格企业 SQL 上，近 30 个模型里最好的 Claude-4-Sonnet 语法错误题对 36%、语义错误题对 32%，多数模型低于 20%。

en.t: Enterprise SQL debugging benchmark: even the best model gets about a third right
en.p: On enterprise-style SQL averaging over 140 lines, the best of nearly 30 models, Claude-4-Sonnet, solved 36% of syntax-bug and 32% of semantic-bug tasks; most models scored below 20%.

zh.t: 译者因 AI 失去工作：有人收入少了七成
zh.p: 一位为欧盟机构做翻译的译者说，机器翻译普及后收入减少约 70%；美国翻译协会会长称很多译者正在离开这一行。牛津学者估计，如果没有机器翻译，原本还会多出约 2.8 万个翻译岗位。

en.t: Translators are losing work to AI, some say income fell 70%
en.p: A translator who worked for EU institutions says machine translation cut his income by about 70%; the American Translators Association's president says many are leaving the field. An Oxford economist estimates about 28,000 more translator jobs would have been added without machine translation.

zh.t: 加州法院取消全州推广 AI 翻译的计划，要先审查准确性
zh.p: 30 多个县级法院曾在柜台试用语音翻译工具；倡导团体通过公开记录整理出多起译错的例子，有职员更愿意用电话人工翻译。

en.t: California courts cancel a statewide AI translation rollout pending an accuracy review
en.p: More than 30 county courts had piloted a voice translation tool at service counters; advocates documented many mistranslations through records requests, and some staff preferred a phone interpreting service.

zh.t: 57% 的营销代理公司放慢或暂停招聘新人，执行类工作交给 AI
zh.p: Sunup 调查了 225 位美国代理公司高管：所有公司都在用 AI，91% 预计 AI 会减少人手，基础设计和出图是常见用途之一。

en.t: 57% of marketing agencies have slowed or paused entry-level hiring as AI takes execution work
en.p: Sunup surveyed 225 US agency leaders: all of their agencies use AI, 91% expect it to reduce headcount, and basic design and image generation are among the common uses.

zh.t: 企业调查：只有 18% 说 AI 减少了对设计师的需求
zh.p: 大多数企业已经在用 AI 设计工具，但主要用来加快出图；需要差异化的品牌和创意工作仍然交给设计师。

en.t: Business survey: only 18% say AI has reduced their need for human designers
en.p: Most businesses already use AI design tools, but mainly to speed up production; differentiated brand and creative work still goes to designers.

zh.t: AI 语音助手开始承担护士的宣教和随访电话
zh.p: Hippocratic AI 和克利夫兰诊所等医院合作推出 Nurse Co-Pilot，负责入院宣教、患者教育、照护者沟通和用药依从；WellSpan 的 AI 语音助手每月接打超过 16 万通患者电话。

en.t: AI voice assistants are taking over nurses' patient-education and follow-up calls
en.p: Hippocratic AI's Nurse Co-Pilot, built with Cleveland Clinic and other systems, covers admission education, patient education, caregiver engagement and medication adherence; WellSpan's AI voice agent handles over 160,000 patient calls a month.

zh.t: 护士工会调查：相当多护士不认同 AI 生成的风险评估和交班记录
zh.p: 美国最大的护士工会 National Nurses United 在推动联邦层面的护患配比立法，工会主席不相信「AI 护士」能取代人的护理。

en.t: Nurses' union survey: many nurses disagree with AI-generated risk assessments and shift hand-offs
en.p: National Nurses United, the largest US nurses' union, is pushing for federal safe-staffing ratios; its president is not convinced AI 'nurses' can replace human care.

zh.t: 电气承包商 Rosendin 在光伏工地试用机器人安装组件
zh.p: 机器人负责搬运和放置光伏板，但紧固和接线仍由现场工人完成。

en.t: Electrical contractor Rosendin tests robots that install solar panels
en.p: Robots carry and set the panels; field workers still fasten them and make the electrical connections.

zh.t: AI 数据中心反而让电工更紧缺
zh.p: 未来十年预计需要 30 多万名新电工；微软总裁称电工短缺是拖慢其美国数据中心建设的头号问题。

en.t: AI data centers are making electricians scarcer, not obsolete
en.p: More than 300,000 new electricians are projected to be needed over the next decade; Microsoft's president called the shortage the No. 1 problem slowing its US data center buildout.

zh.t: 法律 AI 平台 Harvey 称已进入一半的美国百强律所
zh.p: Harvey 称客户超过 1,000 家、遍布 60 个国家，包括 Am Law 100 中的 50%。数字来自公司自己。

en.t: Legal AI platform Harvey says half of the Am Law 100 now use it
en.p: Harvey says it has more than 1,000 customers in 60 countries, including 50% of the Am Law 100. The figures are the company's own.
